tagline.zh: 最小的病人，最大的決定
tagline.en: The smallest patients, the biggest decisions

desc.zh: 新生兒手術的助手、產房的第一線、家長面前的翻譯。你縫、你算、你解釋。
desc.en: Assistant at neonatal operations, first line in the delivery room, translator for parents. You sew, you calculate, you explain.

desc.zh: 寶寶走到哪你跟到哪。體溫、輸液、鼻胃管、轉送保溫箱，還有讓媽媽安心的那句話。
desc.en: Wherever the baby goes, you go. Temperature, fluids, the nasogastric tube, the transport incubator, and the words that calm a mother.

role.zh: 小兒外科主治醫師（師傅）

about.zh: 講話很小聲，因為「寶寶聽得到」。摸任何一個寶寶之前，先把手放在暖暖包上。
about.en: Speaks very softly because 'the baby can hear'. Warms his hands on a heat pack before touching any infant.

about.zh: 最小的病人、最小的管子、最大的耐心。對瘻管特別警覺。
about.en: The smallest patients, the smallest tubes, the greatest patience. Especially wary of fistulas.

about.zh: 新生兒器械細得像牙籤，她閉著眼睛也數得出來。
about.en: Neonatal instruments are as fine as toothpicks; she can count them blind.

about.zh: 昨天出生，一直吐泡泡，鼻胃管放不下去。爸媽叫他小魚。今天修補。
about.en: Born yesterday, blowing bubbles non-stop, a nasogastric tube that would not pass. His parents call him Little Fish. Repair today.

about.zh: 產前就知道腸子在肚子外面。媽媽說他在肚子裡最愛踢的時間是半夜兩點。
about.en: Known from the antenatal scan: bowel outside the abdomen. His mother says his favourite kicking time was two in the morning.

about.zh: 結構性超音波看到橫膈疝氣。她和先生帶著一張寫滿問題的紙來，第一個問題只有五個字。
about.en: The anomaly scan showed a diaphragmatic hernia. She and her husband bring a page full of questions; the first one is five words long.

about.zh: 產房的聲音。她打來的時候，通常只剩幾分鐘。
about.en: The voice of the labour ward. When she calls there are usually only minutes left.

role.zh: 新生兒加護夜班護理師

about.zh: 夜班。血氧掉一格她就看一次管路，掉兩格她就打電話。
about.en: Night shift. One point down on the saturation and she checks the tubing; two and she phones.

plain.zh: 食道中間沒有接通，上段是一個盲端。寶寶吞不下口水，會一直吐泡泡。
plain.en: The gullet does not connect; the upper part ends in a blind pouch. The baby cannot swallow saliva and blows bubbles.

plain.zh: 氣管和食道之間多了一條不該有的通道。空氣會跑進胃，胃酸會跑進肺。
plain.en: An abnormal passage between windpipe and gullet. Air gets into the stomach and stomach acid into the lungs.

plain.zh: 一組常常一起出現的先天異常：脊椎、肛門、心臟、氣管食道、腎臟、四肢。找到一個就要找其他的。
plain.en: A group of birth anomalies that tend to occur together: spine, anus, heart, trachea-oesophagus, kidney, limbs. Find one, look for the rest.

plain.zh: 把兩段食道縫接起來的地方。張力越大越容易漏。
plain.en: Where the two ends of the gullet are stitched together. The more tension, the more likely a leak.

plain.zh: 肚臍旁邊的腹壁有一個缺口，腸子沒有包膜直接露在外面。
plain.en: A gap in the abdominal wall beside the navel, with the bowel exposed and no covering membrane.

plain.zh: 腸子從肚臍突出，但外面有一層膜包著。常合併其他異常。
plain.en: Bowel protruding through the navel inside a membrane. Often with other anomalies.

plain.zh: 一個透明的袋子套住露出的腸子，吊起來，每天一點一點把腸子推回肚子裡。
plain.en: A clear bag placed over the exposed bowel and suspended, so the bowel can be eased back a little each day.

plain.zh: 肚子裡的壓力。腸子推回去太快，壓力太高，會壓到腎臟、血流和呼吸。
plain.en: The pressure inside the abdomen. Push the bowel back too fast and it squeezes the kidneys, the circulation and breathing.

plain.zh: 橫膈有一個洞，腹腔器官跑進胸腔，那一側的肺長不大。
plain.en: A hole in the diaphragm lets abdominal organs into the chest, so the lung on that side cannot grow.

plain.zh: 開放式的床，上方有加熱燈。新生兒失溫很快，手術室也要調暖。
plain.en: An open cot with a heater above. Newborns lose heat fast, so even the theatre is warmed.

plain.zh: 劃刀前全隊停下來，核對病人、部位、手術名稱和體重。
plain.en: Before the incision the whole team stops to confirm patient, site, operation and weight.

plain.zh: 食道修補後，抽痰管只能到標記的深度，不能碰到吻合口。
plain.en: After an oesophageal repair the suction catheter goes only to the marked depth, never to the anastomosis.

text.zh: 開放式的加熱床。體溫探頭貼在肚子上，床會自己調。
text.en: An open heated cot. The temperature probe on the abdomen lets the bed regulate itself.

text.zh: 有輪子的保溫箱，自帶氧氣、監視器和抽吸。從產房到加護病房，寶寶在裡面不會冷。
text.en: An incubator on wheels with its own oxygen, monitor and suction. From delivery room to NICU the baby never gets cold.

text.zh: 比成人的小一半，比牙籤細。鑷子夾的是只有幾公釐的食道壁。
text.en: Half the size of adult ones and finer than toothpicks. The forceps hold a gullet wall a few millimetres thick.

name.zh: 小魚的胸腹部 X 光
name.en: Little Fish's chest and abdomen film

text.zh: 鼻胃管捲在上食道盲端，胃裡有氣。這一張就診斷了有瘻管的食道閉鎖。
text.en: The nasogastric tube coiled in the upper pouch and gas in the stomach: one film diagnoses atresia with a fistula.

text.zh: 透明的袋子，吊在保溫台上方。每天擠一點，腸子一點一點回家。
text.en: The clear bag suspended above the warmer. A little squeezed each day, and the bowel goes home bit by bit.

text.zh: 腹裂寶寶出生的前幾分鐘：保溫、補水、保護腸子。三件事同時做。
text.en: The first minutes of a gastroschisis baby: keep warm, replace fluid, protect the bowel. All three at once.

text.zh: 兩段食道距離越遠，縫起來越緊，越容易漏。寧可分期，不要硬拉。
text.en: The further apart the two ends, the tighter the join and the likelier a leak. Better to stage than to pull.

note.zh: 交班完成，小魚準備手術

lines.zh: 手術室比平常暖。白板上寫著：08:30 小魚，食道閉鎖修補。旁邊畫了一條魚。
lines.en: The theatre is warmer than usual. On the board: 08:30 Little Fish, oesophageal atresia repair. Someone has drawn a fish beside it.

lines.zh: 早。新生兒器械已經消好，保溫台和手術台都預熱了。蘇醫師在看小魚的 X 光。
lines.en: Morning. Neonatal set sterilised, warmer and table both pre-heated. Dr Su is looking at Little Fish's film.

lines.zh: 謝謝。我先去看片子。
lines.en: Thanks. I will look at the film first.

guide.zh: 去燈箱看小魚的 X 光
guide.en: Look at the film on the light box

lines.zh: 早。小聲一點，小魚在隔壁。這張片子告訴你什麼？
lines.en: Morning. Quietly, Little Fish is next door. What does this film tell you?

question.zh: 鼻胃管捲在上胸部，胃裡有空氣。這是哪一型的食道閉鎖？
question.en: The nasogastric tube is coiled in the upper chest and there is gas in the stomach. Which type of atresia?

answer.zh: 有遠端氣管食道瘻管的食道閉鎖，最常見的一型。胃裡的空氣只能從氣管經瘻管進來。
answer.en: Oesophageal atresia with a distal tracheo-oesophageal fistula, the commonest type. The only way air reaches the stomach is from the windpipe through the fistula.

post.zh: 對。所以 VACTERL 要找齊：心臟超音波做了、脊椎和腎臟看了、肛門檢查了。
post.en: Right. So VACTERL must be complete: echocardiogram done, spine and kidneys looked at, anus examined.

post.zh: 都做了。心臟正常，其他沒有異常。
post.en: All done. Heart normal, nothing else found.

lines.zh: 小魚的爸媽在門口。你蹲下來，跟他們一樣高，把手術畫在紙上：先綁瘻管，再接食道。
lines.en: Little Fish's parents are at the door. You crouch to their level and draw it: tie off the fistula, then join the gullet.

lines.zh: 最大的風險是吻合口漏，因為兩段之間有一點距離。我們會小心，而且術後會很慢地開始餵。
lines.en: The main risk is an anastomotic leak, because there is a gap between the ends. We will be careful, and feeds start slowly after.

guide.en: Set up the warmer and transport

lines.zh: 你檢查轉送保溫箱的電量和氧氣，把體溫探頭貼好，幫小魚戴上小帽子。
lines.en: You check the transport incubator's battery and oxygen, stick the temperature probe on and put a tiny hat on Little Fish.

lines.zh: 手暖了嗎？好，我們去接他。
lines.en: Hands warm? Good, let us go and get him.

lines.zh: 各位，時間暫停。
lines.en: Everyone, time-out.

lines.zh: 小魚，出生第二天，食道閉鎖併氣管食道瘻管，右側開胸修補。體重已核對。
lines.en: Little Fish, day two of life, oesophageal atresia with a tracheo-oesophageal fistula, right thoracotomy and repair. Weight checked.

post.zh: 誘導的時候我會盡量讓他自己呼吸，正壓會從瘻管把胃吹起來。胃一脹，你們就要快。
post.en: At induction I keep him breathing for himself as long as I can; positive pressure blows up the stomach through the fistula. If it distends, you move fast.

lines.zh: 進胸了。先找瘻管，不是先找食道。為什麼？
lines.en: We are in the chest. Find the fistula first, not the gullet. Why?

lines.zh: 瘻管一結紮，麻醉就安全了，胃也不會再脹。
lines.en: Once the fistula is tied, anaesthesia is safe and the stomach stops inflating.

post.en: Airway pressures are steady. Thank you.

lines.zh: 兩端的距離可以接。張力有一點，所以每一針都要均勻。你來縫後壁。
lines.en: The gap is bridgeable. Some tension, so every bite must be even. You do the back wall.

post.zh: 好。抽痰深度標記寫在床頭，抽痰管永遠不能到吻合口。
post.en: Good. Write the suction depth mark at the bedside: the catheter must never reach the anastomosis.

lines.zh: 關胸前清點。這些器械比針還細，你幫我對第二次。
lines.en: Count before closing. These are finer than needles; second-check me.

lines.zh: 紗布、針、器械，數目相符。體溫整台維持正常。
lines.en: Swabs, needles, instruments all correct. Temperature held normal throughout.

guide.en: The key line of the op note

lines.zh: 你在手術紀錄上寫：吻合口張力輕度，抽痰深度標記，依醫囑延遲開始餵食。
lines.en: You write: mild anastomotic tension, suction depth marked, feeds delayed per protocol.

sub.en: 10:30 · the phone and the delivery room

note.zh: 豆豆出生的第一分鐘處理完成

sub.zh: 腹裂寶寶，十分鐘內剖腹
sub.en: Gastroschisis baby, caesarean in ten minutes

lines.zh: 小兒外科嗎？產前診斷腹裂的那位，胎心不穩，我們十分鐘內剖腹。
lines.en: Paediatric surgery? The antenatal gastroschisis: fetal heart unstable, caesarean within ten minutes.

lines.zh: 我們現在下去。請把輻射保溫台開到最熱，準備透明腸袋和轉送保溫箱。
lines.en: We are coming down now. Warmer on full, clear bowel bag and transport incubator ready, please.

lines.zh: 豆豆出來了，哭聲很大。腸子在肚臍右側外面，沒有膜包著：是腹裂，不是臍膨出。
lines.en: Dou-Dou is out and loud. Bowel outside, to the right of the navel, with no membrane: gastroschisis, not an omphalocele.

lines.zh: 熱、水、腸子。三件事同時做。你先。
lines.en: Heat, fluid, bowel. All three at once. You first.

guide.en: How do you cover the bowel?

lines.zh: 護理師遞給你兩樣東西：一個透明腸袋，一疊濕紗布。
lines.en: The nurse holds out two things: a clear bowel bag and a stack of wet gauze.

q.en: How do you protect the exposed bowel?

options.zh: 放進透明腸袋，寶寶右側臥
options.en: Into the clear bag; baby on the right side

why.zh: 透明袋保溫、保濕、還看得到腸子的顏色。右側臥避免腸繫膜扭轉。
why.en: The clear bag keeps heat and moisture in and lets you see the bowel's colour. Right lateral prevents the mesentery kinking.

options.en: Wrap in wet gauze, lie flat

why.zh: 濕紗布會帶走熱量，腸子看不到顏色，而且平躺時腸繫膜可能扭轉。
why.en: Wet gauze draws heat away, hides the bowel's colour, and flat on the back the mesentery can kink.

options.en: Try to push the bowel back in now

why.zh: 肚子還沒準備好，硬推會讓腹內壓飆高。先保護，再分期復位。
why.en: The abdomen is not ready; forcing it raises the intra-abdominal pressure. Protect first, reduce in stages.

lines.zh: 轉送保溫箱來了。上車前的順序，你排。
lines.en: The transport incubator is here. Before we roll: put the steps in order.

q.zh: 腹裂寶寶轉送前的順序？
q.en: Before transferring a gastroschisis baby, what order?

steps.en: Bowel in a clear bag, right lateral

steps.zh: 靜脈路徑與輸液依醫囑
steps.en: IV access and fluids per protocol

steps.zh: 轉送保溫箱，監視器上路

post.zh: 媽媽問可不可以看一眼。
post.en: Mum asks if she can see him.

post.zh: 可以。三十秒，隔著袋子。他很漂亮。
post.en: Yes. Thirty seconds, through the bag. He is beautiful.

lines.zh: 你看腸子的顏色。比產房的時候暗，而且他的體溫掉了。濕紗布吸走了熱。
lines.en: Look at the bowel colour. Darker than in the delivery room, and his temperature has dropped. The wet gauze stole the heat.

lines.zh: ……換透明袋，保溫台調高。我記住了。
lines.en: ...Clear bag now, warmer up. Lesson learned.

lines.zh: 腸子顏色很好，體溫正常。透明袋選對了。
lines.en: Bowel colour is good and his temperature is normal. The bag was the right call.

lines.zh: 腸子腫、肚子小，一次關不起來。矽膠袋，分期復位。來。
lines.en: Swollen bowel, small abdomen: it will not close in one go. A silo and staged reduction. Go.

post.zh: 吊好。每天擠一點，看尿量、看呼吸、看腿的顏色。
post.en: Suspended. A little each day; watch the urine output, the breathing, the colour of the legs.

guide.zh: 到諮詢桌見陳小姐夫婦
guide.en: Meet the Chens at the desk

sub.zh: 陳小姐夫婦已到諮詢室
sub.en: Ms Chen and her husband are in the counselling room

lines.zh: 醫師，超音波說是橫膈疝氣。我只想問一句：孩子會活嗎？
lines.en: Doctor, the scan says a diaphragmatic hernia. I only want to ask one thing: will the baby live?

lines.zh: 高主治把暖暖包放到一邊，拉了椅子坐到她旁邊，看著你。
lines.en: Dr Kao sets the heat pack aside, pulls a chair up beside her and looks at you.

post.zh: 先天性橫膈疝氣的關鍵是肺。出生那天不急著開刀，先讓肺和心臟穩下來。
post.en: With congenital diaphragmatic hernia the key is the lung. We do not rush to operate on day one; the lung and heart come first.

post.zh: 可以，而且應該。產房、新生兒加護和我們在同一棟樓。出生的那一刻我們會在。
post.en: Yes, and you should. Labour ward, NICU and us in the same building. We will be there the moment he is born.

lines.zh: 第一次擠一點。手要穩、要慢。看監視器。
lines.en: First squeeze, a little. Steady and slow. Watch the monitor.

options.zh: 停止復位、放鬆矽膠袋、檢查通氣與尿量
options.en: Stop, loosen the silo, check ventilation and urine

why.zh: 血壓掉、腿變花，是腹內壓太高。先退一步，寶寶會告訴你他的極限。
why.en: Falling pressure and mottled legs mean the intra-abdominal pressure is too high. Step back; the baby tells you his limit.

why.zh: 再推下去會壓到腎臟和下腔靜脈。復位是用天算的，不是用分鐘。
why.en: Pushing on squeezes the kidneys and the vena cava. Reduction is measured in days, not minutes.

options.en: Just speed up the fluids and carry on

why.zh: 原因是壓力，不是容量。先解除壓力。
why.en: The problem is pressure, not volume. Relieve the pressure first.

post.zh: 好。今天到這裡。腿的顏色回來了。
post.en: Good. That is enough for today. The legs have pinked up.

lines.zh: 你在護理紀錄寫下：復位時血壓下降、下肢花斑，放鬆後恢復。下一班會感謝這一行。
lines.en: You chart: pressure fell and legs mottled during reduction, recovered on loosening. The next shift will thank you for that line.

note.en: Handed over to the night team

guide.en: Hand over to the night team

lines.zh: 小魚：食道閉鎖修補，瘻管已結紮，吻合口張力輕度。抽痰深度標記在床頭，不能超過。
lines.en: Little Fish: atresia repaired, fistula ligated, mild anastomotic tension. Suction depth mark at the bedside; never past it.

lines.zh: 豆豆：腹裂，矽膠袋，第一次復位時血壓掉，已放鬆。明天再試。
lines.en: Dou-Dou: gastroschisis, silo, pressure dropped on first reduction, loosened. Try again tomorrow.

lines.zh: 陳小姐留了一張紙條給你們：「謝謝你們沒有騙我們。」
lines.en: Ms Chen left you a note: 'Thank you for not lying to us.'

lines.zh: 今天你最想記住的一件事？
lines.en: The one thing you want to remember from today?

lines.zh: 先找瘻管，不是先找食道。還有，腸子要用透明袋。
lines.en: Find the fistula first, not the gullet. And the bowel goes in a clear bag.

lines.zh: 還有一件：摸寶寶之前，手要先暖。回家吧。
lines.en: One more: warm your hands before you touch a baby. Go home.

note.zh: 小魚的夜間血氧處理完成

sub.zh: 小魚血氧往下掉，分泌物多
sub.en: Little Fish desaturating, lots of secretions

lines.zh: 醫師，小魚血氧掉了兩格，口水很多，呼吸有痰音。管路我看過了。
lines.en: Doctor, Little Fish is two points down, lots of saliva, rattly breathing. I have checked the tubing.

options.zh: 抽痰只到床頭的深度標記，給氧，我馬上到
options.en: Suction only to the bedside depth mark, oxygen, I am coming

why.zh: 分泌物是最常見的原因。抽痰可以，但抽痰管絕對不能到吻合口。
why.en: Secretions are the commonest cause. Suction, yes, but the catheter must never reach the anastomosis.

options.en: Deep suction until it is all clear

why.zh: 抽痰管碰到吻合口可能把它弄破。這是術後最不能犯的錯。
why.en: A catheter at the anastomosis can tear it. The one postoperative error you cannot make.

options.en: A few firm squeezes with the bag

why.zh: 用力正壓會把剛修好的地方撐開。先抽痰、給氧、找原因。
why.en: Forceful positive pressure stresses the fresh repair. Suction, oxygen, find the cause first.

post.zh: 好，只到標記。血氧回來了。
post.en: Right, only to the mark. Saturation is coming back up.

lines.zh: 小魚睡著了，泡泡少了很多。隔壁的豆豆在矽膠袋下面踢腳，離他最愛的半夜兩點還早。
lines.en: Little Fish is asleep, far fewer bubbles. In the next cot Dou-Dou is kicking under his silo, well ahead of his favourite two in the morning.

lines.zh: （訊息）阿琳跟我說了。你沒有讓任何人把管子伸過標記。晚安，手記得暖。
lines.en: (message) A-Lin told me. You let nobody pass the mark. Good night, and keep those hands warm.

sub.zh: 兩個寶寶、一對父母、一雙暖過的手
sub.en: Two babies, one couple, two warmed hands
